name: aionstruct-ai-builder
description: Semantic AI planning, deterministic lowering, inspection, preview, and offline compilation of original Minecraft Bedrock structures.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and compile Bedrock structures offline.
interface.longDescription: A constraint-first structure studio for AI Minecraft development. Author semantic Plan v1 components and dependencies, lower them to strict Blueprint v1, inspect final voxel IR, prove traversal and fixture support, render engineering and light previews, then compile deterministic .mcstructure bytes without Minecraft Editor.
defaultPrompt: Design an original Bedrock house as a semantic Plan and render its engineering board.
Audit this AIONSTRUCT blueprint for traversal and lighting defects.
Compare two designs, then compile the validated Blueprint to deterministic .mcstructure bytes.
